content:
oncall-tim: Alert: embedder eu-west1 showing 5xx spike (~5%). Root cause: KV cache index bug in v2.1.3. Built v2.1.4-hotfix. Need expedited roll (skip 10m canary).

deploy-bot: HOTFIX REQUEST service=embedder region=eu-west1 image=embedder:v2.1.4-hotfix-kvcache trigger=alert-embed-5xx

sam: Can you confirm scope? global traffic or localized?

oncall-tim: Localized to eu-west1, synthetic repro 3/5 runs. Fix is small off-by-one in kv lookup. Image pushed.

maya: Security scan ok. No permission changes. +1 from security.

loren: SRE +1 to expedite if we set explicit rollback triggers and smoke tests. Add traffic cutback rule if node failures >2/2m.

squad-pm-lee: Product ok. Leave release note here and update status page after.

eng-lead-janet: I approve skip-canary for eu-west1 only. Conditions: rollback triggers and post-deploy smoke.

oncall-tim: Rollback criteria: sustained 5xx >1% for 3min OR p95 +300ms for 5min OR logs contain "kv-index-fail" after deploy.

deploy-bot: APPROVALS RECEIVED (4). Executing deploy skip_canary=true rollout_strategy=immediate

deploy-bot: Step 1/4 drain -> OK

deploy-bot: Step 2/4 apply image -> OK

deploy-bot: Step 3/4 run smoke `./tools/embedder-quick-check --region eu-west1`

oncall-tim: smoke x10 queries PASS, no 5xx. Logs show kv-index patch.

deploy-bot: Step 4/4 finalize -> 100% traffic. Telemetry: 5xx back to baseline, p95 stable.

oncall-tim: Support notified, status page updated (RED-1234). Post-deploy verification scheduled +15m.

eng-lead-janet: Marking mitigated. Follow-up RCA and metric diff in ticket.

sam: Nice work. :tada:
